verses.en: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
verses.pt: Meus irmãos, não tenhais a fé em nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, Senhor da glória, em acepção de pessoas.
verses.en_web: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.
verses.en_bbe: My brothers, if you have the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory, do not take a man's position into account.

verses.en: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
verses.pt: Porque, se entrar na vossa reunião algum homem com anel de ouro no dedo e com traje esplêndido, e entrar também algum pobre com traje sórdido.
verses.en_web: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in;
verses.en_bbe: For if a man comes into your Synagogue in fair clothing and with a gold ring, and a poor man comes in with dirty clothing,

verses.en: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:
verses.pt: e atentardes para o que vem com traje esplêndido e lhe disserdes: Senta-te aqui num lugar de honra; e disserdes ao pobre: Fica em pé, ou senta-te abaixo do escabelo dos meus pés,
verses.en_web: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing, and say, “Sit here in a good place”; and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”;
verses.en_bbe: And you do honour to the man in fair clothing and say, Come here and take this good place; and you say to the poor man, Take up your position there, or be seated at my feet;

verses.en: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
verses.pt: não fazeis, porventura, distinção entre vós mesmos e não vos tornais juízes movidos de maus pensamentos?
verses.en_web: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
verses.en_bbe: Is there not a division in your minds? have you not become judges with evil thoughts?

verses.en: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?
verses.pt: Ouvi, meus amados irmãos. Não escolheu Deus os que são pobres quanto ao mundo para fazê-los ricos na fé e herdeiros do reino que prometeu aos que o amam?
verses.en_web: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, my dear brothers; are not those who are poor in the things of this world marked out by God to have faith as their wealth, and for their heritage the kingdom which he has said he will give to those who have love for him?

verses.en: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
verses.pt: Mas vós desonrastes o pobre. Porventura não são os ricos os que vos oprimem e os que vos arrastam aos tribunais?
verses.en_web: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?
verses.en_bbe: But you have put the poor man to shame. Are not the men of wealth rulers over you? do they not take you by force before their judges?

verses.en: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?
verses.pt: Não blasfemam eles o bom nome pelo qual sois chamados?
verses.en_web: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?
verses.en_bbe: Do they not say evil of the holy name which was given to you?

verses.en: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:
verses.pt: Todavia, se estais cumprindo a lei real segundo a escritura: Amarás ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo, fazeis bem.
verses.en_web: However, if you fulfill the royal law, according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.
verses.en_bbe: But if you keep the greatest law of all, as it is given in the holy Writings, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself, you do well:

verses.en: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
verses.pt: Mas se fazeis acepção de pessoas, cometeis pecado, sendo por isso condenados pela lei como transgressores.
verses.en_web: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.
verses.en_bbe: But if you take a man's position into account, you do evil, and are judged as evil-doers by the law.

verses.en: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
verses.pt: Pois qualquer que guardar toda a lei, mas tropeçar em um só ponto, tem-se tornado culpado de todos.
verses.en_web: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.
verses.en_bbe: For anyone who keeps all the law, but makes a slip in one point, is judged to have gone against it all.

verses.en: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
verses.pt: Porque o mesmo que disse: Não adulterarás, também disse: Não matarás. Ora, se não cometes adultério, mas és homicida, te hás tornado transgressor da lei.
verses.en_web: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery, but murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.
verses.en_bbe: For he who said, Do not be untrue in married life, is the same who said, Put no man to death. Now if you are not untrue in married life, but you put a man to death, the law is broken.

verses.en: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
verses.pt: Falai de tal maneira e de tal maneira procedei, como havendo de ser julgados pela lei da liberdade.
verses.en_web: So speak, and so do, as men who are to be judged by a law of freedom.
verses.en_bbe: Let your words and your acts be those of men who are to be judged by the law which makes free.

verses.en: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.
verses.pt: Porque o juízo será sem misericórdia para aquele que não usou de misericórdia; a misericórdia triunfa sobre o juízo.
verses.en_web: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
verses.en_bbe: For the man who has had no mercy will be judged without mercy, but mercy takes pride in overcoming judging.

verses.en: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
verses.pt: Que proveito há, meus irmãos se alguém disser que tem fé e não tiver obras? Porventura essa fé pode salvá-lo?
verses.en_web: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
verses.en_bbe: What use is it, my brothers, for a man to say that he has faith, if he does nothing? will such a faith give him salvation?

verses.en: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
verses.pt: Se um irmão ou uma irmã estiverem nus e tiverem falta de mantimento cotidiano.
verses.en_web: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,
verses.en_bbe: If a brother or a sister is without clothing and in need of the day's food,

verses.en: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?
verses.pt: e algum de vós lhes disser: Ide em paz, aquentai-vos e fartai-vos; e não lhes derdes as coisas necessárias para o corpo, que proveito há nisso?
verses.en_web: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace, be warmed and filled”; and yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?
verses.en_bbe: And one of you says to them, Go in peace, be warm and full of food; but you do not give them the things of which their bodies have need, what profit is there in this?

verses.en: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
verses.pt: Assim também a fé, se não tiver obras, é morta em si mesma.
verses.en_web: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.
verses.en_bbe: Even so faith without works is dead.

verses.en: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.
verses.pt: Mas dirá alguém: Tu tens fé, e eu tenho obras; mostra-me a tua fé sem as obras, e eu te mostrarei a minha fé pelas minhas obras.
verses.en_web: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I by my works will show you my faith.
verses.en_bbe: But a man may say, You have faith and I have works; let me see your faith without your works, and I will make my faith clear to you by my works.

verses.en: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
verses.pt: Crês tu que Deus é um só? Fazes bem; os demônios também o crêem, e estremecem.
verses.en_web: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe, and shudder.
verses.en_bbe: You have the belief that God is one, and you do well: the evil spirits have the same belief, shaking with fear.

verses.en: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
verses.pt: Mas queres saber, ó homem vão, que a fé sem as obras é estéril?
verses.en_web: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?
verses.en_bbe: Do you not see, O foolish man, that faith without works is of no use?

verses.en: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
verses.pt: Porventura não foi pelas obras que nosso pai Abraão foi justificado quando ofereceu sobre o altar seu filho Isaque?
verses.en_web: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?
verses.en_bbe: Was not the righteousness of Abraham our father judged by his works, when he made an offering of Isaac his son on the altar?

verses.en: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
verses.pt: Vês que a fé cooperou com as suas obras, e que pelas obras a fé foi aperfeiçoada;
verses.en_web: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected;
verses.en_bbe: You see that his faith was helping his works and was made complete by them;

verses.en: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
verses.pt: e se cumpriu a escritura que diz: E creu Abraão a Deus, e isso lhe foi imputado como justiça, e foi chamado amigo de Deus.
verses.en_web: and the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness”; and he was called the friend of God.
verses.en_bbe: And the holy Writings were put into effect which said, And Abraham had faith in God and it was put to his account as righteousness; and he was named the friend of God.

verses.en: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
verses.pt: Vedes então que é pelas obras que o homem é justificado, e não somente pela fé.
verses.en_web: You see then that by works, a man is justified, and not only by faith.
verses.en_bbe: You see that a man's righteousness is judged by his works and not by his faith only.

verses.en: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
verses.pt: E de igual modo não foi a meretriz Raabe também justificada pelas obras, quando acolheu os espias, e os fez sair por outro caminho?
verses.en_web: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, in that she received the messengers, and sent them out another way?
verses.en_bbe: And in the same way, was not the righteousness of Rahab, the loose woman, judged by her works, when she took into her house those who were sent and let them go out by another way?

verses.en: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
verses.pt: Porque, assim como o corpo sem o espírito está morto, assim também a fé sem obras é morta.
verses.en_web: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.
verses.en_bbe: For as the body without the spirit is dead even so faith without works is dead.
